subject: Finalizing MAP: hosting mode and region selection for MediCloud
messages:
From: Ananya Rao <ananya@medicloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicloud.com>, MediCloud Legal <legal@medicloud.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: hosting mode + region — need final recommendation and timeline

Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our execs want a short, actionable plan we can include in the procurement packet: can you confirm Redwood's recommended hosting mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private) for our initial production rollout and a target region? Key constraints: PHI handling (US only), 99.9% p99 latency target for inference under steady load (~120 rps), and a procurement window that requires sign-off by 2027-05-15.

We've attached our internal timeline; I sketched a MAP in Drive (link below). High-level ask: recommend a path that minimizes time-to-live while addressing compliance and cost for year 1. If dedicated is required for legal, please include the procurement milestones and lead times.

Appreciate a short decision note we can share with our CIO.

Thanks,
Ananya Rao
VP Product, MediCloud

Attachments: MediCloud_internal_timeline.xlsx (attached by sender)
Drive: https://drive.medicloud.com/teams/product/maps/MAP-draft

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Rao <ananya@medicloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting mode + region — need final recommendation and timeline

Hi Ananya — thanks for the clear asks. I've drafted a short decision note and MAP items below; putting Karthik and Laura on copy to validate capacity and procurement steps.

Summary recommendation (short):
- Start on Redwood Dedicated in US-East (primary) with Hosted API fallback for burst/DR.
- Reasons: guaranteed capacity to meet p99 under committed throughput; VPC isolation and KMS/HSM hooks satisfy PHI controls; fastest procurement-to-production runway compared to full on-prem.

High-level MAP items and deadlines (we'll put in the shared Drive):
1) Legal review & DS agreement redline — MediCloud (5/05) -> Redwood (5/07)
2) Dedicated capacity sizing & cost estimate — Redwood (5/04) -> MediCloud (5/06) [attached estimate]
3) SOC2 evidence & infra checklist exchange — Redwood (5/04)
4) Network setup (VPC peering/VPN) prep — parties agree on IPs (5/08)
5) Pilot cutover window (canary traffic) — target 5/20
6) Production go-live (post procurement & infra setup) — target 6/01

If you prefer Hosted to avoid procurement friction we can scope a phased approach: Hosted for first 30 days (limited to US regions), then Dedicated cutover once procurement completes (we'll build blue/green). Karthik — can you confirm lead time for Dedicated pool allocation if we commit by 5/07?

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-capacity-estimate.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting mode + region — need final recommendation and timeline

Irene / Laura — confirming capacity lead times and a few constraints:
- If MediCloud signs a 6-12 month committed Dedicated contract by 2027-05-07, we can reserve a 4-GPU pool in US-East and provision within 7 business days.
- Hardware provisioning (if larger than 4 GPUs) moves to 14 business days.
- VPC peering + enterprise networking window typically requires 3-5 business days from when IPs and firewall rules are exchanged.
- SOC2 evidence packet: we can provide the standard bundle by EOD 5/04; for PHI-specific controls (key management attestations) Markus will lead a short write-up.

Two operational notes for MAP:
- Recommend including a Hosted fallback rule in the MAP (traffic spillover to hosted API in a regionally constrained manner) — keeps the app live during Dedicated capacity replenishment.
- If procurement demands data residency strictly in customer-managed on-prem, we should surface the Private deployment path early (longer lead time, >6 weeks).

Markus — can you draft the KMS/HSM attestation snippet for Ananya? I'll update the MAP with the procurement milestones and cost delta for the hosted fallback.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Rao <ananya@medicloud.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting mode + region — need final recommendation and timeline

Ananya — attaching the SOC2 evidence summary and a short KMS/HSM attestation. Quick note: our HSM integration supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or GCP CloudHSM in US-East, with key rotate audit logs available for compliance review.

If you want, we can add a one-page appendix to the MAP that lists the exact evidence items your compliance team will want (logs, rotation proofs, key access lists).

-Markus Klein
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

> On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 08:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Markus — can you draft the KMS/HSM attestation snippet for Ananya? I'll update the MAP with the procurement milestones and cost delta for the hosted fallback.

From: Ananya Rao <ananya@medicloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicloud.com>, MediCloud Legal <legal@medicloud.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: hosting mode + region — need final recommendation and timeline

Irene / team — thanks, this is helpful and concise. MediCloud accepts Redwood's recommendation to start on Dedicated in US-East with Hosted fallback. A few quick asks before we close the MAP and move to procurement:
- Can Redwood produce a single-page summary that our CIO can sign and include in the procurement packet? (Decision + high-level MAP items + dates)
- Please confirm final cost estimate for the first 3 months (include Hosted fallback delta).
- Legal will send a redline by 5/10; please confirm you can turn around within 48 hours.

We'll aim to sign the commitment by 5/12 so your provisioning lead times should work. I'll upload our updated MAP to your Drive link and share the procurement packet later today.

Thanks — Ananya
VP Product, MediCloud

Attachments: none
